record.source_title: Co-op Scheme - Winter 2026 at A&O Shearman
record.source_summary: A seven-month COOP internship in Riyadh with January and August intakes. The official page describes hands-on legal work across corporate transactions, disputes, research and drafting.
record.offer_summary: Seven-month Riyadh placement, January or August intake, mentorship and a monthly expense allowance.
responsibilities: Assist lawyers with legal research, drafting and documentation.
Support legal opinions, client presentations and team meetings.
Contribute to corporate transactions, disputes and other legal matters.
qualifications: Currently enrolled as an undergraduate law student.
A strong cumulative GPA and successful completion of the firm’s assessment are required.
Fluent spoken and written Arabic and English.
A university letter must confirm that COOP training is a graduation requirement.
record.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate Law student; Arabic and English; strong GPA; assessment; COOP must be a graduation requirement.
record.eligibility_source_text: The official posting requires current undergraduate law enrolment, Arabic and English fluency, a strong GPA, an assessment, and a university letter confirming COOP as a graduation requirement.
record.editorial_assessment: The clearest dated Saudi early-career opening in this feed. It provides direct exposure to international transactions and disputes; possible future trainee consideration is mentioned, but not promised.
record.deadline_source_text: 30 November 2026 at 5pm (timezone not stated by source)

start.discrepancy: Exact vacancy describes January and August intakes; official Saudi COOP overview describes December or January depending on university terms. No start date or year is inferred.

copy.titleEn: A&O Shearman — Co-op Scheme – Winter 2026, Riyadh
copy.summaryAr: برنامج حضوري مدته سبعة أشهر لطلاب بكالوريوس القانون. تشمل الشروط سجلًا أكاديميًا قويًا وإجادة العربية والإنجليزية تحدثًا وكتابةً. يلزم قبل البدء خطاب جامعي يؤكد أن التدريب التعاوني من متطلبات التخرج. يذكر الإعلان بدل مصروفات شهريًا دون تحديد قيمته.
copy.summaryEn: An office-based, seven-month programme for undergraduate Law students. Requirements include a strong academic record and spoken and written fluency in Arabic and English. Before starting, applicants need a university letter confirming that COOP training is a graduation requirement. The advert lists a monthly expense allowance without stating the amount.
copy.deadlineAr: آخر موعد معلن: 30 نوفمبر 2026، الساعة 5 مساءً؛ المنطقة الزمنية غير مذكورة. تُراجع الطلبات تباعًا.
copy.deadlineEn: Published deadline: 30 November 2026 at 5 pm; the timezone is not stated. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
copy.applicationNoteAr: يبدأ التقديم من صفحة الوظيفة المطابقة ثم تسجيل الدخول؛ لم يُرسل أي طلب.
copy.applicationNoteEn: The matching job leads to sign-in to continue; no application was submitted.

record.source_summary: A Riyadh student internship listed as a current opportunity on Segal Law Firm’s first-party careers site. The role provides substantive legal exposure, research, structured learning and responsibility from the outset, with possible consideration for future opportunities.
record.offer_summary: Riyadh internship for current law students. No posting date, deadline, programme duration or compensation is stated on the verified vacancy page.
responsibilities: Work on real legal matters and conduct legal research.
Take meaningful responsibility within Segal teams from the outset.
Develop legal and commercial skills through practical experience and structured learning.
Gain exposure to different areas of legal practice and firm initiatives.
qualifications: Current law student at a recognised university.
Strong spoken, written and reading ability in Arabic and English.
Genuine interest in law and business.
Right to work in Saudi Arabia for the duration of the internship.
record.eligibility_summary: Current law student; strong Arabic and English; consistently strong academic record; interest in law and business; right to work in Saudi Arabia during the internship.
record.eligibility_source_text: The first-party vacancy states that candidates must be current law students at a recognised university, have a consistently strong academic record, be strong Arabic and English speakers/readers/writers, have a genuine interest in law and business, and have the right to work in Saudi Arabia for the internship.
record.editorial_assessment: A verified Saudi early-career route with substantive legal exposure and possible future consideration. The posting does not allocate interns to a specific corporate, finance or fintech practice, so practice-area relevance should not be overstated.

copy.titleEn: Segal Law Firm — Student Intern, Riyadh
copy.summaryAr: فرصة لطلاب القانون الملتحقين حاليًا بجامعة معترف بها، مع سجل أكاديمي قوي وإجادة العربية والإنجليزية تحدثًا وقراءةً وكتابةً. يشترط امتلاك حق العمل في السعودية طوال مدة التدريب. يشمل التدريب خبرة عملية وبحثًا قانونيًا مع دعم وإرشاد من الفريق.
copy.summaryEn: An opportunity for current law students at a recognised university, with a strong academic record and spoken, reading and written proficiency in Arabic and English. Applicants must have the right to work in Saudi Arabia throughout the internship. The placement includes practical experience and legal research with team support and guidance.
copy.deadlineAr: الموعد النهائي والمدة والمكافأة: غير مذكورة في الإعلان.
copy.deadlineEn: Deadline, duration and compensation: not stated in the advert.
copy.applicationNoteAr: نموذج التقديم العام متاح مع اختيار «Student Intern»؛ لم يُرسل أي طلب.
copy.applicationNoteEn: The public application form has Student Intern selected; no application was submitted.
